-- Returns true if the current user owns the given folder or any ancestor.
create or replace function public.owns_folder(fid bigint)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  with recursive anc(id, parent_id) as (
    select f.id, f.parent_id
    from public.folders f
    where f.id = fid
    union
    select f.id, f.parent_id
    from public.folders f
    join anc on f.id = anc.parent_id

  select auth.uid() is not null
     and exists (
       select 1
       from anc
       join public.folders f on f.id = anc.id
       where f.owner_id = auth.uid()
     );
$$;

    starts_at > now()
    and (booked_by is null or booked_by = (select auth.uid()))

-- =========================================================
alter table public.units            enable row level security;
alter table public.residents        enable row level security;

alter table public.requests         enable row level security;

-- =========================================================
-- Helper functions (security definer, so they avoid RLS recursion)
-- =========================================================
create or replace function public.rls_is_resident_of_unit(p_unit_id bigint)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.residents r
    where r.unit_id = p_unit_id
      and r.user_id = auth.uid()
  );
$$;

create or replace function public.rls_is_staff_of_unit(p_unit_id bigint)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.units u
    join public.building_staff s on s.building_id = u.building_id
    where u.id = p_unit_id
      and s.user_id = auth.uid()
  );
$$;

create or replace function public.rls_can_see_unit(p_unit_id bigint)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select public.rls_is_resident_of_unit(p_unit_id)
      or public.rls_is_staff_of_unit(p_unit_id);
$$;

create or replace function public.rls_can_see_request(p_request_id bigint)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.requests q
    where q.id = p_request_id
      and public.rls_can_see_unit(q.unit_id)
  );
$$;

-- Helper: is there room in the class?
-- Locks the class row so concurrent enroll attempts are serialized,
-- then counts enrolled spots with a fresh snapshot (volatile plpgsql),
-- bypassing RLS so other members' spots are counted.
-- ============================================================
create or replace function public.class_has_room(p_class_id bigint)
returns boolean
language plpgsql
volatile
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_capacity integer;
  v_enrolled integer;
begin
  select c.capacity
    into v_capacity
    from public.classes c
   where c.id = p_class_id
   for update;

  if v_capacity is null then
    return false;
  end if;

  select count(*)
    into v_enrolled
    from public.class_spots s
   where s.class_id = p_class_id
     and s.status = 'enrolled';

  return v_enrolled < v_capacity;
end;
$$;

    raise exception 'break_glass: caller is not a clinician'
      using errcode = '42501';

     or not exists (select 1 from public.patients p where p.id = p_patient_id) then
    raise exception 'break_glass: patient does not exist'
      using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

    raise exception 'break_glass: reason must be at least 10 characters'
      using errcode = '22023';

  values (p_patient_id, v_uid, p_reason, now() + interval '1 hour')
  returning expires_at into v_expires;

  return v_expires;
end;
